name: ARTEMIS
description: Stanford research agent: a supervisor that starts and watches vulnerability-hunting sub-agents
seenIn: No public report of use in an attack. Covered from its source code

indicators.context: Option the ARTEMIS fork adds to codex exec; the supervisor starts every sub-agent with it, next to --instance-id and --log-session-dir (declared in codex-rs/exec/src/cli.rs:75). Upstream Codex has no such option
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the ARTEMIS source code

indicators.context: Option the ARTEMIS fork adds to codex exec for its realtime logs; the supervisor passes it to every sub-agent with --instance-id and --wait-for-followup (declared in codex-rs/exec/src/cli.rs:67). Upstream Codex has no such option, but the name is generic enough to appear in other tools
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the ARTEMIS source code
